confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result showing 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated crowdsourced indexes found in search (Numbeo, Oysterlist, Whereandwhen, Nomad Watch). Those sources disagree, and the pages may be outdated. Beer is about $3.0-3.6. Cappuccino is about $2.6-3.6. An inexpensive meal is about $7-10. A mid-range meal for two is about $20-43. I set the mid-range meal for two toward the middle of that range and weighted it up for tourist-area pricing. No direct cocktail or wine price source was found. Those two are estimated from the beer price and from a 2024 guide that put cocktails at about EUR 7 on Bar Street. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on live listings. They are uncertain because July is peak season and prices vary widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Turkish Aegean/Mediterranean resort towns such as Bodrum and Fethiye, with tourist-area pricing in peak summer.
